memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Avery explicitly made a trip-specific exception by choosing the later 10:35 a.m. replacement rather than the earliest workable outbound, while preserving the unaffected return and hotel.

messages.content: Southwest changed Monday's outbound and it now lands after 9:00 p.m. I need to be at the museum at 8:00 Tuesday morning, so please check the replacement choices. Do not touch Thursday's Delta flight or the Cheshire reservation.

The schedule change qualifies for a no-cost change or refund on the Southwest outbound. Two practical replacements still have seats: Southwest WN 1863 leaves ATL at 7:05 a.m. and reaches STL at 7:50 a.m.; Southwest will move you to it for no additional fare, and your suitcase and supply case remain included. Delta DL 2216 leaves at 2:40 p.m. and arrives at 3:27 p.m.; replacing only the outbound would require a $38 fare difference plus $35 for the supply case.
Is there anything between those? Seven in the morning is much earlier than I wanted, but after 9 at night is unusable.

There is one more same-day option with availability: Southwest WN 2950, ATL 10:35 a.m. to STL 11:22 a.m. The airline can rebook it at no charge under the schedule-change waiver, with both bags included. It would put you at the Cheshire around 12:15 p.m.; the hotel can hold the bags until the room is ready.
That sounds better. Before changing it, confirm that this is only the Monday segment and that the Thursday 4:15 p.m. Delta return remains exactly as booked.

Confirmed. The waiver can be applied solely to Southwest confirmation L8Q2RM. Delta DL 1284 on Thursday, STL 4:15 p.m. to ATL 6:48 p.m., remains under H6T9VK, and the Cheshire stay remains October 12-15 under CHS-804621.

For this trip only, take the 10:35 a.m. outbound even though I generally would have accepted the earliest workable flight. The extra preparation time after an 11:22 arrival is enough, and I do not want to add $73 for Delta.
Understood. I’ll exchange the disrupted Monday Southwest flight for WN 2950 at no additional charge and leave every other reservation unchanged.
Go ahead, and give me the updated flight record once it is confirmed.

Rebooked under Southwest confirmation L8Q2RM: WN 2950 departs ATL Monday, October 12 at 10:35 a.m. and arrives STL at 11:22 a.m. The exchange cost was $0, and the suitcase and checked supply case remain included. Delta DL 1284 is unchanged for Thursday at 4:15 p.m. under H6T9VK. The Cheshire reservation for October 12-15 is also unchanged.
